== Title ==
<span lang="ja">K-3PO (ケイ・スリーピオ)</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">戦闘を宣言し、また宣言されることができる。ホスかヤヴィン4では同じ位置にいる自分のドロイド1体ごとにK-3POの戦闘力は＋1となる。他の自分のドロイドが最低1体以上、同じ場所にいるなら、リーダーとして働く。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">旧型の通訳用ドロイド。ナーラ中佐のために働きながら軍事戦術を学んだ。エコー基地のドロイド置き場の管理を任されている。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — K-3PO (Kay-Threepio).

'''Lore''' — Old-model interpreter droid. It learned military tactics while working for Commander Narra. It is in charge of the droid storage at Echo Base.

'''Game text''' — May declare battle and be battled. On Hoth or Yavin 4, K-3PO is power +1 for each of your droids at the same location. If at least one other of your droids is at the same place, it functions as a leader.

One asterisk precedes the title. Printed subtype is 通訳用ドロイド. Lore omits “May initiate battle and be battled” and uses ドロイド置き場. The power bonus is each of your droids at the same 位置, matching original printed English rather than “other droids”.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-k3pokaythreepio-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[K-3PO (Kay-Threepio)]].</ref>
